name: Benzoate
summary: Sodium benzoate, also known as benzoate of soda, is the sodium salt of benzoic acid, widely used as a food preservative (with an E number of E211) and a pickling agent. It appears as a white crystalline chemical with the formula C6H5COONa.

uses.text: Sodium benzoate, also known as benzoate of soda, is the sodium salt of benzoic acid, widely used as a food preservative (with an E number of E211) and a pickling agent.

summaryZh: 苯甲酸鈉是苯甲酸的鈉鹽，化學式為C6H5CO2Na，是一種白色結晶固體。苯甲酸鈉是很常用的食品保存劑，E編碼為E211。
summaryZhHans: 苯甲酸钠是苯甲酸的钠盐，化学式为C6H5CO2Na，是一种白色结晶固体。苯甲酸钠是很常用的食品保存剂，E编码为E211。

pharmacology.en: As a preservative it works by entering mould and yeast cells and acidifying them, which stops them growing. In the brain it blocks the enzyme D-amino acid oxidase, which raises D-serine, a helper at the NMDA receptor.
pharmacology.zh: 作為防腐劑，它進入黴菌與酵母細胞並使其酸化，從而阻止生長。在大腦中，它阻斷 D-胺基酸氧化酶，使 NMDA 受體的輔助物 D-絲胺酸濃度上升。
pharmacology.zhHans: 作为防腐剂，它进入霉菌与酵母细胞并使其酸化，从而阻止生长。在大脑中，它阻断 D-胺基酸氧化酶，使 NMDA 受体的辅助物 D-丝胺酸浓度上升。

sideEffects.en: As a food additive it can trigger hives and worsen asthma in sensitive people. In the acid conditions of a soft drink it can react with vitamin C to form small amounts of benzene.
sideEffects.zh: 作為食品添加物，它可能在敏感者身上引發蕁麻疹並加重氣喘。在汽水的酸性環境中，它可能與維生素 C 反應生成少量苯。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为食品添加物，它可能在敏感者身上引发荨麻疹并加重气喘。在汽水的酸性环境中，它可能与维生素 C 反应生成少量苯。

fact.en: Sodium benzoate is a food preservative, number E211, and occurs naturally in cranberries, prunes and cinnamon. It is not a psychoactive drug, though it has been studied as an add-on in schizophrenia.
fact.zh: 苯甲酸鈉是食品防腐劑，編號 E211，天然存在於蔓越莓、西梅與肉桂中。它不是精神作用藥物，但曾被研究作為精神分裂症的輔助用藥。
fact.zhHans: 苯甲酸钠是食品防腐剂，编号 E211，天然存在于蔓越莓、西梅与肉桂中。它不是精神作用药物，但曾被研究作为精神分裂症的辅助用药。
